tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.devil_splitter.1: Deals double damage to the Nehemoth,
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.devil_splitter.2: and killing one mends it a little.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.devil_splitter.3: Strike the same foe six times within twenty seconds:
Each foe of size you kill with it loads a charge.
Use it to fire a laser that burns what it crosses.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.crystallized_dagg: The lower your health, the faster it strikes.
Some kills may leave a crystallized fragment.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.horn_of_apocalyps: Cuts everything alive nearby and blocks its healing.
